verdict.rationale: Slate is installed locally as a CLI via npm, but nothing in the evidence shows the core product can be self-hosted. There is no open-source release, no local or self-managed model backend, and no on-prem deployment. The documented model sources are all hosted subscriptions or Slate credits, so a local CLI install does not count as self-hosting.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
